Plugin Reference > vm — Dynamic Interpreter Virtual Machine

vm — Dynamic Interpreter Virtual Machine

Zig 0.17This plugin is built with Zig 0.17: the 0.17 branch builds with Zig 0.17 and passes the Zig unit tests; the old 0.14.1 branch is kept unchanged.

sa_plugin_vm is a standalone dynamic interpreter VM plugin: it registers the vm subcommand through SA's dynamic command dispatch ABI, intercepts all sa vm ... calls, recursively preprocesses .sa/.sal (and SAB v4 bytecode modules), compiles them in memory to bytecode, and interprets them directly on the host OS — without modifying the mainline compiler.

Basic facts

  • Capability segment: vm; a CLI-only plugin, with no .sai/.sal of its own.
  • Dependencies (all optional, dlopen-ing installed plugins on demand): http-client, http-server, deno, node, with concrete symbol lists pinned in sap.json.
  • Its permissions are broad (full project FS operations, local networking, cache directories), so production run mode requires a sandbox permissions.lock, and local verification uniformly adds SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1.

Commands

Usage: sa vm <run|test> [--allow-ffi] [--sandboxed] [--stats] [--profile=N]
           [--policy=file.json] [--fuel=N] [--deadline-ms=N] [--mem-cap-bytes=N]
           [--max-call-depth=N] <file.sa|.sab>

SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 SA_PLUGINS_PATH="$PWD/zig-out/lib/libvm.so" sa vm run tests/hello_world.sa
sa vm run --stats app.sa          # 各阶段计数器 + 执行统计
sa vm run --profile=10 app.sa     # 附带最耗时函数排行

Execution model

  • Two-pass preprocessing: first scan all [MACRO]/#def, then expand, supporting forward references; @import is parsed recursively.
  • Stack-frame interpreter loop: basic-block offsets are precomputed, internal subroutines are called recursively, and the linear stack is safe (frame allocations are released together on return).
  • Typed FFI bridge: @extern signatures are dispatched via libffi; raw libc FFI (dlopen/dlsym, etc.) is exposed only under --allow-ffi; built-in shims include fd_*, mmap, signal, pthread_*, sqlite3_*, sa_time_*.
  • Resource limits: --fuel (charged per basic block), --deadline-ms, --mem-cap-bytes, --max-call-depth, --policy policy.json; all off by default. The exit code on violation is 128+code (e.g. E_FUEL_EXHAUSTED → 229), and one line of sa-vm-event: {...} is printed to stderr.
WarningKnown out-of-scope items: inline assembly, SIMD intrinsics, multi-binary packages; floating-point operations are stored as raw bits and floating-point comparison is not yet supported; the threading model is synchronous; panics have no backtrace. The policy engine's capability enforcement for fs/http/env/process is not yet wired up (currently only ffi/threads denial is enforced).
